title: Aloha Spirits brewery liquor license and zoning limits
summary: As of September 9, 2026, no liquor license will be issued to the brewery until it meets the zoning clearance requirement. Staff said the Planning Department raised new zoning questions about one applicant's planned uses. The applicant's attorney said zoning may not allow selling kegs or cases to stores, restaurants or bars.
